article.story: Coastal Carolina (4-6) at Louisiana (7-3), Nov. 21 at 3 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Louisiana by 10.5. Against the spread: Louisiana 6-3-1, Coastal Carolina 5-5. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Louisiana Offense Overall: 385.9 yards per game (63rd in FBS) Passing: 175.4 yards per game (120th) Rushing: 210.5 yards per game (18th) Scoring: 31.1 points per game (43rd) Louisiana Defense Overall: 327.9 yards per game (35th in FBS) Passing: 184.4 yards per game (23rd) Rushing: 143.5 yards per game (73rd) Scoring: 21.7 points per game (42nd) Coastal Carolina Offense Overall: 358.6 yards per game (86th in FBS) Passing: 240.7 yards per game (47th) Rushing: 117.9 yards per game (118th) Scoring: 25 points per game (89th) Coastal Carolina Defense Overall: 388.5 yards per game (99th in FBS) Passing: 215.7 yards per game (76th) Rushing: 172.8 yards per game (103rd) Scoring: 24.3 points per game (65th) Coastal Carolina ranks 118th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 43.2% of the time. Louisiana ranks 47th on offense, converting on 42.1% of third downs. Coastal Carolina is 67th in the FBS with an even turnover margin, compared to Louisiana's 17th-ranked +6 margin. Coastal Carolina is 130th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 72% of trips. Louisiana's red zone defense ranks 72nd at 84%. Coastal Carolina is 89th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 29:28, compared to Louisiana's 14th-ranked average of 32:28. Team leaders Louisiana Passing: D'Wayne Winfield, 1,664 yards, 8 TDs, 6 INTs, 66.4 completion percentage Rushing: Winfield, 604 yards on 136 carries, 10 TDs Receiving: KeDarius Wade, 300 yards on 16 catches, 2 TDs Coastal Carolina Passing: Deuce Bailey, 2,386 yards, 20 TDs, 9 INTs, 57.8 completion percentage Rushing: Dominic Knicely, 508 yards on 109 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Colton Hinton, 452 yards on 24 catches, 4 TDs Last game Louisiana beat UL Monroe 42-21 on Nov. 12. Winfield led Louisiana with 65 yards on 7-of-13 passing (53.8%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 37 yards. Steven Blanco had 113 rushing yards on 15 carries and one touchdown. Brock Chappell put up 24 yards on two catches. Coastal Carolina won 28-21 over Arkansas State on Nov. 14. Bailey led Coastal Carolina with 208 yards on 21-of-24 passing (87.5%) for one touchdown and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 10 times for 15 yards and one rushing touchdown. Kente Edwards carried the ball 15 times for 38 yards and scored one touchdown, adding one reception for one yard. Hinton put up 81 yards on six catches. Next game Louisiana plays at Georgia State on Nov. 28. Coastal Carolina plays at James Madison on Nov. 28.
